_comment: Onboarding Strategy Report input schema. Values below are NeezaNizam (SG property) placeholders for illustration — the schema is vertical-agnostic. See SKILL.md + references/page-layouts.md for field semantics. Remove all _comment fields before passing to generate_pdf.py.

business_context.vertical: sg_property | saas_b2b | ecommerce_dtc | local_service | info_products | real_estate_us | healthcare | agency | default

dream_translation.client_exact_words: The client's own words from discovery — quoted verbatim on the cover
dream_translation.surface_goal: What they asked for (the stated problem)
dream_translation.underlying_why: The real driver beneath the stated problem

diagnostic.primary_constraint_rationale: One sentence explaining why this is the single bottleneck
diagnostic.calculator_close_note: Plain-language derivation of the dollar figure using the per-vertical benchmark

avatars.name: Avatar Name
avatars.buying_trigger: Life event or realization that triggers the buy

existing_ads_audit.zero_blame_header: Nothing that happened before today is anyone's fault. This page exists so we can solve the problem together.

findings_aaa.finding: Factual statement of what we observed
findings_aaa.acknowledge: Validate past logic — it was reasonable at the time
findings_aaa.associate: Link to a peer with the same issue who solved it
findings_aaa.ask_pivot: Can I share what changed for them?
findings_aaa.skill_deficiency_reframe: The platform works — the gap is a learnable skill in X

strategy_preview.note: Angle THEMES only. No finished copy. No headlines. No playbooks. Those are the engagement.

more: More of the pain that compounds

value_days_31_60.focus: Value — quick win + monthly value reminder

expectation_language.example: On average, clients who complete X see Y within Z. Half see it faster, half see it slower. This is what we'll aim for, not guarantee.

assets_included.name: Asset name (e.g., swipe file, cultural guidelines)

next_meeting_bamfam.purpose: Brief statement of what the next meeting will cover

benchmark_references: Source 1 for the Calculator Close numbers
Source 2 for any other stats cited
